decisions.reason: The message appears to extend the $20 amount to no-referral mints but also calls their commissions $18 and $8, so no single commission amount can be propagated safely.
The commission amount change does not alter coded-referral ticket quantity, recipient, or promotional-mint exclusion rules.
The landing-page requirements still mandate $10 coded-referral commission copy, which necessarily becomes stale when the coded-referral commission changes to $20.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
At this point, 34 mints should correspond to 34 tickets and 34 x $20 commissions.

A mint still produces a ticket and commission even when no referral code is supplied.

Accounting works correctly on the leaderboards and NFT attributes whenever a code is used. That part is perfect.

Without a referral code, the ticket and commission are assigned randomly, but both must still appear on the leaderboard and in the NFT attributes.

Since your latest fix, the randomly assigned tickets from the last 7 mints seem to have been recorded correctly, which is great. The earlier missing tickets have not been backfilled, though.

The $18 commissions generated by these no-code buys are also still missing from the leaderboard and NFT attributes.

My screenshot shows an NFT with 9 tickets but only 4 x $20 commissions. That should be impossible because every ticket comes with a $18 commission.

The leaderboard screenshot accounts for only 15 tickets and 12 x $8 commissions from 34 total mints. Regardless of whether a referral code was supplied, 34 mints should produce 34 tickets and 34 x $20 commissions.

value_updates.mechanics_tease_text: Emphasize the $20 unlimited, instant coded-referral commission and the opportunity to win $900 every 750 sales without repetitive or overly sales-focused wording.
value_updates.commission_copy_requirement: Make the $20 coded-referral commission amount, unlimited nature, and immediate timing clear.

decisions.reason: Changing the coded-referral commission amount does not alter how an NFT's referral code is sourced, persisted, or displayed.
The commission amount change does not alter the established one-ticket rule or random allocation for no-referral mints.
The commission amount change does not affect referral-code eligibility or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The current FAQ requirements explicitly describe $10 coded-referral commissions and must reflect the new $20 coded-referral amount.
